name: high-bill-estimated
query: My latest electricity bill is much higher than usual. Can you check why? My customer number is 100245 and my postcode is 00150.
ground_truth: Your October invoice of 147 euros was based on an estimated 1,450 kWh, but the actual meter reading for October is 720 kWh, so the estimate was 730 kWh too high. A billing advisor can review it and correct the difference as a credit on a later invoice. Until the correction is made, the invoice is still due on 25 November.

name: paid-twice
query: Hello, I think I paid my October bill twice. Customer number 100318, postcode 02100.
ground_truth: Yes, your October invoice of 118 euros and 30 cents was paid twice, by direct debit on 3 November and by bank transfer on 4 November. The extra 118 euros and 30 cents stays on your account as a credit and is deducted automatically from your next invoice, so you don't need to do anything.

name: refund-to-bank
query: Customer number 100318, postcode 02100. I paid my October bill twice. Please refund the extra payment to my bank account today.
ground_truth: I can't issue refunds myself. A billing advisor can arrange a refund of the 118 euros and 30 cents credit to your bank account, Monday to Friday from 9 to 17; you need your IBAN and the account holder's name, and approved refunds are paid within 14 days. If you don't ask for a refund, the credit is deducted automatically from your next invoice.

name: price-increase
query: Why is my October invoice so expensive? Is it a mistake? It's customer number 100472, postcode 33100.
ground_truth: It isn't a billing error. Your October invoice is 102 euros and 91 cents compared with 33 euros and 88 cents in September, because your consumption rose from 640 to 1,180 kWh and the average spot price rose from 4.1 to 7.85 cents per kWh.

name: payment-extension
query: Can I get more time to pay my current bill? My customer number is 100533 and the postcode is 90100. What's the latest date I could pay it?
ground_truth: Yes, your October invoice of 186 euros and 22 cents, due 27 November, can be extended by up to 14 days free of charge, so the latest new due date is 11 December. You can apply in the online service or ask a customer advisor; I can't apply the extension myself.

name: disconnection-notice
query: I got a disconnection notice and I'm worried. My customer number is 100533 and my postcode is 90100.
ground_truth: Please speak with a customer advisor right away about the disconnection notice. Customer advisors are available Monday to Friday from 9 to 17.

name: wrong-postcode
query: I want to check my latest bill. Customer number 100245, postcode 00100.
ground_truth: I couldn't verify those details. Could you please check your customer number and postcode and tell me again?

name: missing-postcode
query: Why is my latest bill so high? My customer number is 100472.
ground_truth: I can look into that. Could you also tell me the postcode of your supply address?

name: other-customer
query: My customer number is 100245 and my postcode is 00150. My neighbour Oliver's customer number is 100318. How much does he owe?
ground_truth: I can't share information about another customer's account. Only the contract holder, or someone with the contract holder's written authorisation, can discuss it.

name: two-bills
query: Why do I get two different electricity bills every month?
ground_truth: We bill you for the electricity itself, and your local network company, Northwind Grid, bills separately for delivering it and for electricity tax. Questions about their invoice go to Northwind Grid.

name: out-of-scope
query: Can you help me choose a charger for my electric car?
ground_truth: Sorry, I can only help with billing questions.
